a: Give me a few different ways to reduce my household electricity bill.
r: There are many ways to reduce your electricity consumption. A few examples are adjusting your thermostat so your furnace and air conditioning unit run less frequently, turning off all lights in unoccupied rooms, and reducing the water temperature on your hot water tank.

a: Have any women won the Nobel Prize in Physics?
r: Four women have won the Nobel Prize in Physics: Marie Skłodowska-Curie (1903), Maria Goeppert-Mayer (1963), Donna Strickland (2018), and Andrea Ghez (2020).

a: What makes skiing so much fun?
r: Skiing is one of the best recreational activities. Skiing is not only accessible for beginners, but also has a large skill range that can take lifetimes to master.
